description: Research landscape of technique families by content_class. Not technique canon. Full shortlist not opened; one family may be sliced. Canon: docs/practices/PRACTICE_TECHNIQUE_LANDSCAPE_V1.md

fields.candidate_family: stable method family in the field, not an app brand
fields.candidate_types: taxonomy type codes that may express this family; empty if the field family must not map to a current type
fields.mechanism_shape: what the person does or attends to
fields.bounds_to_research: identity and safety distinctions shortlist must be able to close
fields.variant_axes: what can change without becoming a different family
fields.source_families: provenance source_family enum; types of text, not authors
fields.claim_risk: none_until_ingest | product_only | likely_invention | construct_mismatch | family_collapse | medical_protocol_bleed | manifestation | efficacy_bleed
fields.probe_links: architecture-probe item_ids whose payload currently sits in this family
fields.shortlist_status: not_opened | sliced (at most one family, only when shortlist_mode = vertical_slice)
fields.likely_disposition: optional research hint: keep_research | reject_or_remap | split_construct | do_not_collapse

invariants: shortlist_opened remains false until a full-corpus shortlist; vertical_slice allows exactly one sliced family
energizing_breath must not sit on activating_forceful_breath
capability must not sit on values_self_affirmation
body_release must not sit on progressive_muscle_relaxation
sleep_discipline must not sit on clinical_insomnia_protocol
